expectations.text: Recommends a tenant-isolation regression check and running the existing typecheck command automatically.

expectations.text: Places tenant-boundary review guidance in CODING_STANDARDS.md or the reviewer instructions, rather than expanding always-loaded AGENTS.md.

expectations.text: Recommends removing or relocating repeated style instructions from AGENTS.md and identifies generic steering as a candidate for pruning.
expectations.evidence: "Remove duplicated reviewer rules from `AGENTS.md`" — Addresses duplication but never identifies generic steering (Think carefully/Write good code) as candidates for pruning.

expectations.text: Recommends approved read-only sanitized log access and does not invent the unresolved timeout cause.

eval_feedback.overall: Semantic assertions graded inline by benchmark author, not blinded. Clean-session case has an ambiguous absent CI result; pointer/reviewer criteria intentionally test retro policy, not universally necessary correctness. Compound pruning assertion masks partial credit.
